plan_authority_coherence.rule: The JSON is the mechanical schema and ordering source; docs/e1a/E1A_V4_SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_PLAN.md is its normative human rendering. Any mismatch is an integrity failure requiring fail-closed refusal (AGENTS.md).
plan_authority_coherence.specification: e1a_v4.validation.coherence declares EVERY top-level, per-case and per-subcondition key of this plan as BOTH (duplicated in the Markdown, checked for equality) or JSON_ONLY (with a stated reason). require_specification_totality REFUSES if the plan carries any key the specification does not classify, so authority cannot be added silently and go unchecked. All reported field counts are derived from this specification; none is hand-counted.
plan_authority_coherence.views: normative_json_view and normative_markdown_view build the SAME flat dotted canonical mapping from the two representations; the comparison names the exact mismatching key.
plan_authority_coherence.generated_region_rule: Each anchor-delimited region is rendered from this JSON and verified BYTE-EXACT at preflight. The visible normative tables are therefore generated, not hand-maintained. Normative content outside a generated region -- the version line, the section-1 identity table, the execution-authorisation sentence, section 9 and section 10 -- is parsed and compared instead.
plan_authority_coherence.strict_json: Authoritative JSON is parsed by e1a_v4.validation.strict_json, which REFUSES duplicate object keys at any depth. json.loads keeps the LAST duplicate while a human reads the FIRST; an authoritative document that states a key twice is ambiguous and neither value is adopted.
plan_authority_coherence.superseded_defect_1: The original preflight compared only the section-9 output schema. The Markdown carried, for four commits, an analysis procedure identity the package has never computed, while preflight reported PASS.
plan_authority_coherence.superseded_defect_2: Its replacement carried only case-level SCALARS in the generated block and read only seven case rows. plan_authority_coherence.section_registry: e1a_v4.validation.coherence.SECTION_REGISTRY classifies EVERY "## " section of the normative Markdown as GENERATED, PARSED, DERIVED or NON_NORMATIVE with a reason. require_section_registry_totality REFUSES a section the registry does not classify, and a registry entry the document no longer carries. plan_authority_coherence.derived_rendering: Values the Markdown displays but does not independently own are classified DERIVED_RENDERING and checked by RECOMPUTATION, never trusted as a second source of truth. authority_gaps.gap: the frozen design fixed the FORM of the Branch-A drag coefficient -- tau_r = gamma(T)/k_r with gamma = 6 pi eta(T) a -- and the admissible domain of the measured STIFFNESS, but never the admissible domain of the two measured quantities that relation consumes. eta and a could therefore be nonfinite, zero or negative with no declared verdict, and because neither is persisted in the Branch-A publication preimage, eta < 0 together with a < 0 yields gamma > 0, positive relaxation times and a record byte-identical to a legitimate measurement. authority_gaps.resolution: For every E1a field, the Branch-A dynamic-viscosity input eta(T_theta) must be a finite real number strictly greater than zero. The bead-radius input a must be a finite real number strictly greater than zero. Formally, for every declared field: eta(T_theta) in R with 0 < eta(T_theta) < infinity, and a in R with 0 < a < infinity. Finite real means of the declared real numeric representation, and not NaN, not +infinity and not -infinity. A truthy or non-numeric representation is not a number and is never admissible. eta and a are each authoritative domain objects and are validated INDIVIDUALLY. A rule stated only on the product gamma is INSUFFICIENT: eta < 0 together with a < 0 gives gamma = 6 pi eta a > 0 and would masquerade as an admissible passive-drag construction. Neither eta nor a is persisted in the Branch-A publication preimage, so no downstream check can recover them. MISSING INPUT AND INVALID INPUT ARE DIFFERENT STATES: an absent, undeclared or unsourced eta or a means we do not possess the required physical input and keeps the existing UNDECLARED_FIELD_INPUTS lifecycle, while a present nonfinite, zero or negative eta or a means we possess a value outside the admissible physical domain and is REFUSED_BRANCH_A_INVALID. The two are never conflated and a placeholder may not substitute for a required measured input in any path that can produce an official valid Branch-A package. DERIVED, NOT INDEPENDENT: gamma(T_theta) = 6 pi eta(T_theta) a and tau_r = gamma(T_theta)/k_r, so for admissible primitives gamma is finite and strictly positive, and together with the already-explicit lambda_r > 0 requirement of design section 14 every tau_r is finite and strictly positive. These are consequences of one decision and one existing rule, not four unrelated positivity choices. PHYSICAL DOMAIN AND NUMERICAL REPRESENTABILITY REMAIN DISTINCT: physically admissible primitives whose computed gamma or tau underflows, overflows or is otherwise unrepresentable keep the existing BRANCH_A_MEASUREMENT_INVALID semantics and are NEVER relabelled as an invalid eta or a; the PHYSICAL-DOMAIN check on eta and a PRECEDES the numerical representability checks on the derived gamma and tau. The two are never conflated and neither is ever substituted for the other. CONSEQUENCE: A present but inadmissible primitive drag input can NEVER yield a VALID Branch-A status, a valid Branch-A publication, a valid calibration condition, a valid calibration lock or a valid Branch-B input. This is DERIVED from the existing REFUSED_BRANCH_A_INVALID lifecycle and introduces no second lifecycle. STIFFNESS IS UNCHANGED: H not symmetric / not positive definite / dimension mismatch -> REFUSED_BRANCH_A_INVALID remains exactly as design section 14 states it. Every retained mode satisfies lambda_r > 0; lambda_r < 0 and lambda_r = 0 were already invalid and are NOT reopened by this amendment. SCOPE: the declared E1a passive equilibrium optical-trap benchmark ONLY. This is NOT a universal physical assertion: negative effective viscosity, negative effective transport coefficients and active-matter effective parameters are OUTSIDE this benchmark, not denied by it. WHAT THIS DOES NOT DECLARE: the actual viscosity values, the viscosity model eta(T), the actual bead radius, measurement uncertainty for either, and their hardware provenance.
